prompt: Build a tabbed interface to switch between different views of the same page, with a couple of tabs and their content panels. Add a tooltip on a small icon button explaining it.
response:
<bl-tab-group>
  <bl-tab name="overview" slot="tabs">Overview</bl-tab>
  <bl-tab name="details" slot="tabs">Details</bl-tab>
  <bl-tab-panel tab="overview">Overview of the product and its key highlights.</bl-tab-panel>
  <bl-tab-panel tab="details">Additional details, specifications and pricing.</bl-tab-panel>
</bl-tab-group>
<bl-tooltip placement="right">
  <bl-button slot="tooltip-trigger" icon="info" variant="tertiary" size="small" label="More info"></bl-button>
  This tabbed view lets you switch between the overview and the full details.
</bl-tooltip>
